entry_points.summary: Knob header, cost-inversion caveat, NO-OP fallthrough guarantee; PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN/FLASH_PREPEND initialized unconditionally before block
config.py get runtime.impl_pre_review == true AND CYCLE==1 guard; whole block skipped when false
Strips cached **Complexity:** line; dispatches complexity-classifier for LIVE_TIER; drift-up emits tier_drift_detected and forces codex
Low-tier only; probes Flash provider; dispatches pre-reviewer in final-review-prong-a mode; CLEAN skips codex (review_gated_down); MAJORS/BLOCKERS escalates with FLASH_PREPEND
Flash advisory-only for medium/high; VERDICT never gates codex; PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN stays 0
Opt-in via runtime.pre_review; 3 parallel pre-reviewer dispatches (prong-a/b + quality) before Phase 4 consultants; separate from impl_pre_review
Samples review_gated_down events; re-runs codex on archived diffs; reports Flash false-negative rate; read-only; --demo mode for flow testing
Haiku-tier pre-reviewer; 4 modes: final-review-prong-a/b, final-review-quality, plan-audit; emits **VERDICT:** CLEAN|MAJORS_FOUND|BLOCKERS_FOUND; max 4000 chars output
Reused in Step 6.P1 for tier-drift re-check; heuristic #1 returns cached tier if **Complexity:** present — stripping mandatory

invariants: runtime.impl_pre_review=false (default): entire block is NO-OP; byte-identical to today
gate-down only runs on cycle 1; retry cycles always use the full codex reviewer
Flash provider unavailable → fail-safe toward more thorough review (codex runs); never silently skip
tier-drift re-check strips cached **Complexity:** line before dispatching classifier
medium/high tier tasks are never gated down by Flash; Flash may prepend findings but is not authoritative
PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN and FLASH_PREPEND always initialized before knob block
PRE_REVIEW_GATE_DOWN (eligibility, P1) and PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN (skip decision, P2) are two DISTINCT variables — must never be unified; downstream skip-guard reads only GATED_DOWN
runtime.pre_review and runtime.impl_pre_review are independent knobs; enabling one does not enable the other
gotchas: cost-inversion: Haiku-on-all + codex-on-subset can exceed codex-on-all when most tasks are medium/high — run audit before enabling
complexity-classifier heuristic #1 returns cached tier if **Complexity:** present; stripping the line is mandatory for drift detection
Flash verdict parsing uses grep -o 'VERDICT:[[:space:]]*[A-Z_]*'; format deviations yield empty verdict → falls through to codex (safe)
pre-reviewer operates in final-review-prong-a mode in gate-down path (correctness/spec-drift focus); not a generic CLEAN/FAIL oracle
FLASH_PREPEND injected into codex prompt; codex not constrained by Flash findings
Z_HARNESS_IMPL_PRE_REVIEW is now a legacy env alias (transliterated); prefer runtime.impl_pre_review = true in config.toml
models.pre_reviewer in config.toml pins the pre-reviewer model (default empty = resolved via providers.json)

FOOTGUN: PRE_REVIEW_GATE_DOWN vs PRE_REVIEW_GATED_DOWN differ by one letter ('GATE' vs 'GATED'); P1 sets GATE_DOWN=1 when eligible (no drift-up); P2 sets GATED_DOWN=1 only when Flash returns CLEAN on a low-tier eligible task; do NOT unify into one variable
